acceptance: ClickHouse adapter selects native Delta reads vs Parquet snapshot with availability detection
End-to-end test creates a Delta table and reads it via deltaLake on a Docker host
Pinned server image confirmed to ship the deltaLake integration
context: DEFER home for claude review findings 1-3 on commit 801e6c352 (PR 2269): the landed commit provides SQL builders plus a pure availability-detection helper and a registration probe, but no adapter caller, no native-vs-Parquet selection logic, and no data-level end-to-end read (no Docker in the authoring environment; container cannot see host tmp paths). Wiring and e2e belong here, not in the builders commit.
description: Wire native ClickHouse Delta Lake reads into the adapter and cover them end to end. Use benchbox.platforms.clickhouse.delta_lake builders plus the availability helper to choose native reads vs the Parquet snapshot fallback, and add a data-level live test on a Docker host with a server-visible Delta table.
